caption: The drawing features a laundry room with a variety of objects arranged throughout the space. In the foreground on the left side, there is a black cast-iron stove with a large copper boiler sitting on top, and a small metal bucket on the floor beside it. In the center, a wooden barrel-style washing machine with a hand crank and attached wringer is positioned on three legs, and next to it is a metal pail. A wicker laundry basket with white linens is placed on a small red wooden stool nearby. In front of the barrel, there is a wooden washboard on the tiled floor. To the right, two wooden chairs (one green, one brown) face a long ironing board, which holds an old-fashioned iron and folded cloth. Behind these objects, a long wooden counter with drawers lines the back wall, with various items on top, including a baby carriage, weighing scale, green box, brown sack, and bottles. On the left, an open door reveals shelves holding bottles and jars. Along the back wall, metal bed frames are stacked vertically, and a tall, gold-colored metal drying rack stands beside them. The wall is constructed of light gray stone blocks, and there are two small windows with bars near the ceiling, letting in light. On the right, a high double sink with metal stains is fixed to the wall, and there is a washboard and brown shoe brush on the floor below. Above the sink, a wooden shelf holds blue and yellow containers. A straw broom leans against the wall by the stairs, and a red watering can sits on the floor close by. An old-fashioned suspended light fixture hangs from the wooden-beamed ceiling. The dominant colors in the drawing are hues of gray from the stone walls and floor, brown and beige from the wood and furniture, and various accent colors from the objects.
title: Basement of Urban House, 1910
